outcome_statement: Sensitive content (explicit material, PII patterns) observed by the drive channel is redacted at the source before it ever reaches an AI model prompt, the DB log, or the UI -- functionally never seen or recorded.
pain: The drive channel and the new Android AccessibilityService driver can observe anything on screen with zero filtering today -- a real privacy gap now that real driving capability exists.
value: Founder and Sherry can trust the driving capability never records or exposes sensitive personal content, and it's provable (redaction happens at one auditable chokepoint).
success_metrics: Explicit-content domain/keyword in observation text/elements returns a redacted marker, never the original
failure_metrics: Redaction claimed complete/perfect without stating heuristic-v1 limitation
constraints: New file only -- no patch to existing files in this mission
unacceptable_result: Sensitive content passed through unredacted, or the module silently claims complete coverage
ownership: ARC emits machine twin; Builder executes; Adam owns founder usability verdict

point_model.A: Vision -- Adam provides FP in development stage
point_model.B: Chair locks handoff -- corridor protected; Adam done until Alpha
